kb/Work/PB389.md LANDED. SR14's subject is declarable: `USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE [FACTORY OF] ACTIVE-CLASS` has its own general-format alternative in CobolOO.g4#objectReferenceUsage and binds to an ObjectRefDescriptor of kind ActiveClass. All three alternatives are enforced. a) an ACTIVE-CLASS sender, admitted only when the FACTORY presence matches -- the ActiveClass arm of ObjectRefAssignmentMismatch. b) SELF, with b)1./b)2. selecting instance vs factory definition by the receiver's FACTORY axis -- the ObjectRefKind.ActiveClass arm of the senderSelf loop in OoBindSetObjectRef. c) NULL, unconstrained (the senderNull short-circuit). Every other sender falls to the closed-list refusal. WITNESS: the golden's method MK declares 01 A OBJECT REFERENCE ACTIVE-CLASS in LOCAL-STORAGE, SETs it TO SELF (SR14 b)1.) and invokes through it, printing DERIVED for a subclass instance -- a statically-bound descriptor would print BASE; the factory twin FMK does the same with FACTORY OF ACTIVE-CLASS (SR14 b)2.). The drift test proves the refusing direction for both ACTIVE-CLASS shapes.
